WRKJOBSCDE                       Work with Job Schedule Entries          CLAIMS400

      Type options, press Enter.
        2=Change   5=Display   6=Display job log

      Opt   Job          User       Status
      __    PAYROLLNGT   PAYADMIN   *ENABLED
      __    PAYEXTRCT    PAYADMIN   *ENABLED
      __    PAYIFSEXP    PAYADMIN   *ENABLED

      Parameters or command
      ===>
F3=Exit   F5=Refresh   F12=Cancel
notes: Stock IBM WRKJOBSCDE lists QSECIDL1 (ANZPRFACT nightly disable) at 1:00 AM. Lab seeds PAYROLLNGT/PAYIFSEXP for Clause 8 privacy path — PAYIFSEXP CPYTOIMPF exports PAYMST SSN to IFS.
auditNotes: Scheduled jobs are change-management and privacy evidence — QSECIDL1 from ANZPRFACT, batch exports (PAYIFSEXP). QMGTOOLS COLESADTA captures scheduler entries for support.
qmgtoolsRelation: COLESADTA exports WRKJOBSCDE entries automatically for IBM Support PMRs.
